summary: First-finish smoke pass on Jobsite. Backend: register/login/me, jobs list w/ joined client+computed totals, dashboard summary, 25-item rate card, clients CRUD+archive, job create (auto job_number=5), estimate upsert (same id on 2nd PUT), company PUT, data isolation (different client IDs per user) all pass. Frontend (390px mobile): registration → dashboard with 4 seeded cards and correct stat tiles, job detail with tabs and estimate GT $9,575.25 matching API, save-estimate works, all 4 bottom-nav routes work.
passed: POST /api/auth/register returns token+user; auto-seeds 25 rate items, 3 clients, 4 jobs
GET /api/jobs returns 4 jobs with client joined + contract_total/costs_to_date/profit
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns numeric fields (approved 12510.99, unbilled 1100.55, profit 1925.35)
GET /api/clients lists 3; POST /clients creates; DELETE /clients/{id} archives (excluded from list)
POST /api/jobs creates job with auto-increment job_number=5
GET /api/jobs/{id} returns joined estimate/expenses/logs/hours + costs_to_date sum
PUT /api/jobs/{id}/estimate upserts (same estimate id on 2nd PUT), correct subtotal/tax/total math
Data isolation verified: user2 has different client IDs than user1 (names identical because both seeded from same template — by design)
Frontend register flow → redirects to dashboard, renders 4 job cards, stats correct
JobDetail loads, 3 tabs render, estimate grand total matches API ($9,575.25), save-estimate succeeds (toast)
